notes.title: A Novel... But Visual 🤔
notes.content: [p]Yo ✌️[/p][p][/p][p]I'm happy to report that the game finally feels like a real Visual Novel 😍 I've been busy adding UI, animations, sound, and VFX to the dialogue to allow me to make more engaging scenes. I mean, just look at the difference:[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/b31907c9abad346355b2d7da4cf7885d27c53fb8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/d942d0866a385dda1cf0e8f363271e8c3505e86a.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]But that's not all! I've also been hard at work on all of the game's menus, and I'm nearly done! I was feeling particularly inspired to work on UI after giving my talk at Godotcon, which you can view here:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="sjmAD1ZLBcE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]After having spent so much time thinking about UI, I was able to truly harness the energy of the UI Gods, and thereafter coded a whole slew of menus for the game:[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/ba97de876e12467ff74b7b2b4f2902e173c1a1c7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/819e39ad98fd24f1ec31089a441b4faae59e0bb7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/7087c0e923d5eb08c19ff2621b4afe603d2865c1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/ed97d5b1da94b195c58de856abee93267160dfa1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/8890b291a8b9a44bd50a90807d18d01cbbb79e10.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/3bda6ffda1428215a71e1a084b90e3293ef1618a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/5cece40e0ab885e453220903bf7a4b669a0f85a6.png"][/img][/carousel][p]and with that, I think the gameplay systems are like... [b]80% coded??[/b] I still need to add a few more things, like in-match items and stats, shopping, accessibility options etc, but this game is really close to being ready to move into the content phase. I'm so ready. My hope/dream/PLAN is to wrap up the systems by December and move on to creating a playable demo for yall. 💖[/p][p][/p][p]Alright later ![/p]

notes.title: Godotcon Boston 2025 was a blast!
notes.content:
Hi gamers!

My last update was in March, and it's now the end of May - what was I doing those two months? Here's a short update!

[h1]Godotcon Boston[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/7da2b5d41d503b10e243fffe3e21469d115e6f94.jpg[/img]

I recently went to [b]Godotcon Boston[/b], Godot's first ever conference in the US. It was full of tons of indie developers who had a similar passion for the Godot game engine and indie game development in general. This was one of the most fun moments of my entire 5 years as an indie gamedev; I had a [i]fantastic[/i] time meeting and talking to so many cool devs. I learned a ton, got great advice, had good food, and made great connections. My throat was actually sore because of how much I was talking to people over the 3 days! I can't wait to go back next year 🥰

Here's a great video by StayAtHomeDev (who I met there and is super nice!) recapping his experience at the conference:

[previewyoutube=KwwMhC_TnjI;full][/previewyoutube]

I volunteered to help out Nicholas O. from Essay Games with his workshop on Narrative Design, which was really fun and thought provoking. You should check out his heartwarming game, [url=store.steampowered.com/app/3138370  essaygames.itch.io/bundle-of-joy]Bundle of Joy![/url]

I also did a talk, [b]Improving Your UI in Godot[/b]. It was my first videogame talk I've ever done, and I learned a lot. Big thanks to Edd for giving me advice, and my friends at Godotcon who were also giving their first talks who I could build a comradery with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/6817456642d3674e4abf04b0436d3dfa87b55f1f.png[/img]

[url=https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1-w3rbzI1DMDPFMO7NC3Svwb68Pdal8caq9KQH_qsH1I/edit?usp=sharing][b]You can find my slides here![/b][/url] It should also be uploaded on Godot's official youtube soon!

Oh, I also did most of the con's signage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/f956afb9fd4f76965a819c3bfa0256a4537f17b9.jpg[/img]

I made multiple signs, banners, a map, and the convention badge! Thanks so much for giving me the opportunity!

I was busy the past two months preparing all of the con graphics and writing my talk, coding a pause menu for it, and creating graphics for my slides. I put a lot of heart into it! 

[h1]Game Updates[/h1]

After the conference, I came home and immediately got back to work. I had started feeling a little burned out after working hard on the game for 6 months, but the 2 month break for Godotcon was exactly what I needed to feel refreshed and motivated. I'm on a UI kick after my talk, so I've spent the past couple of weeks on a quest to finish all of the Pause menus, and I came up with some cool new in-match UI.

[b]Status Menu:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/561b8e19ce7341421956ecbad06e61b2ca39911c.png[/img]

As with many RPGs, The Tennis Academy has a stats screen where you can see all of your character's stats, as well as their equipped skills and gear. I was kind of surprised at myself that I was able to finish most of the screen in one day! I think I'm getting the hang of Control Nodes in Godot. The Status menu is almost done, I just need to finish the Partner's side of the screen, and I think it would be helpful to show detailed calculations for each stat (like, if you have 30 Power, knowing 15 of that is your base power, 10 is from equipment, and 5 is from a passive could be useful)

I've also been playing a lot of Expedition 33, and you all know I'm a big Persona fan, and.. well, this happened:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/47eca86e409aea6e1f3299f9779411ce950e57b1.png[/img]

Are you even surprised at this point?

I hyperfixated on that for 3 days LOL. It was fun.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

I mentioned this last time, but for this year my overall goal is to reach a point where all of the systems are complete. The list is shortening, so I think this may be doable 😊 Even if not, I'm happy with the progress that's being made. I still want to be able to have a demo next year.

For the next month, I'd like to focus on making all the pause menus functional.

[list]
[*][b]Status Menu[/b] (Partner's screen, stat calculations)
[*][b]Calendar[/b] - check upcoming events, class times, scheduled hangouts, deadlines
[*][b]Tenergy Menu[/b] - change your special shot/ability/passive
[*][b]Journal[/b] - character profiles, recap of the story, tennis glossary (maybe these all need to be their own submenus? 🤔)
[/list]

I think these will be possible in less than a month if I stay focused; I'm getting quick at menus!

[h1]Join the Discord![/h1]

To wrap this up, I will invite you to come and join the Discord - we can talk about The Tennis Academy and more games there 🙂

[url=https://discord.gg/76chERbdzR][b]https://discord.gg/76chERbdzR[/b][/url]

Thanks for reading!
-Rawb 💖

notes.title: 365 Wishlists // 1 Year on Steam!!!
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you!![/h2]

Thank you so much to everyone who's supported this silly little endeavor so far!

It's hard to believe it's been 1 year since I've made the Steam page for THE TENNIS ACADEMY. The game has made SO much progress since then. I'm working on an extensive devlog video for you all to document all of these changes, but it's easy to say the game has majorly evolved in the past year. 

As of today, the game has [b]365 Wishlists![/b] I'm quite happy with that number in the first year, because the game is still in such an early state, so I think it's a good sign that it's able to build a small foundation way before it's ready for any serious marketing. Thank you to all of my friends/family who have supported the game, the discord fam, and anyone who's seen the game online and decided to wishlist. I really appreciate it!

It's not an easy feat by any means to solo-develop a large scale RPG. I definitely wouldn't advise anyone to try doing it as your full-time job unless you've got some serious sugar daddy bucks. Luckily I've gotten settled into a full time job that is pretty stable (assuming our federal government doesn't destroy all of our funding teehee) and I'm able to dedicate a lot of my free time to The Tennis Academy as a hobby.

[h2]Some Updates[/h2]

I've been working pretty hard on the game for 6 straight months since October, and it's come a long way. I'll talk more in detail in the devlog video, but we've got so many features done, menus functional, matches are in a good place, and RPG elements are working. I've done so much that I need a little break from going full steam ahead!

So I've taken a break from the grind of gameplay systems recently and I've been having fun just making art. The cover art for this page is a scene between Nate and Servie that might happen in-game. Here's a couple of other artsy things I worked on this month:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/15dc3afd155bd54645faf1bc77e88c8f6f4fa9af.png[/img]
I've been having a fun time decorating the overworld. This 2D street scene has a parallax cloud effect that turned out pretty nice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/6e6cf879b169a54ac6c36a2c082b8c68252b2b60.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/c8246edb4cd613962885ef54bded916c468636e7.png[/img]
The Player Dorm got a makeover, and now has some pretty drastic lighting differences depending on the time of day! I'm going to spend a lot of hours here browsing memes...

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

I'll have more to update in the devlog video, but my goal for this year is to get to the [b]Production Point[/b] for this game. What's that? It's the moment when all of the game's systems are coded, and I can switch to mainly creating Content. I'm a lot closer to this goal than I've ever been! The systems that still need coded are:

[list]
[*]Shopping (Halfway done)
[*]Items - Consumables, gifts, and room decorations
[*]Courses (Halfway done)
[*]Romance & Doubles Partner passive bonuses
[*]Stats in-match such as Speed, Power, etc (Halfway done)
[*]Menus - Stats, Tenergy, Calendar
[*]Dialogue - Log, Skip, VFX/Emotes/Text Effects
[/list]

this is such a small list compared to when I started! I feel really confident in my ability to get everything done.

Working on the game has been a nice distraction from... The Horrors lol. Remember to focus your energy not on the Horrors but on the Joys! I hope you all have a very nice day - if you want to stay up to date on the game, you can:

[olist]
[b][*]Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/76chERbdzR
[*]Subscribe on Youtube and look out for the Devlog: https://www.youtube.com/@tennisacadrpg
[*]Wishlist if you haven't, and tell a friend to wishlist :)[/b]
[/olist]

Alright, bye!

notes.title: 200 Wishlists Hit!
notes.content:
We've officially hit 200 wishlists! Wow! Here's some Celebratory Yaoi!

I barely expected 2 of you to want my gay tennis game let alone 200 of you. It means a lot!

[b]Doubles Matches in the Works![/b]

I posted this over on Twitter and Bluesky, but I've been working on Doubles matches! This was something I put off for like a year because it was so daunting. I had to go through the [i]entire[/i] match and CPU code and add cases for doubles matches. Not to mention the UI challenges - I fit the doubles partners into the score UI, and I'm not working on redesigning the HP bars to nicely fit all the players. 

Nevertheless, it works! Sort of. You can play a doubles match, but it's kind of janky right now. I'm going to move on to coding more systems, but I'll keep coming back to the matches to try to polish the gameplay as best as I can.

Thank you!

notes.title: A Tiny Devlog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981967/ce7126e8921830c0a7edccebb4aa25ea1fed8998.jpg[/img]
^ Nate, the protagonist of this game :3

Hi gaymers and gamers,

Soo I thought it'd be nice to do a little devlog of sorts, in case anybody actually reads these on Steam. If not, then I'm just talking into a void, which is okay too I guess? I'm no stranger to talking to myself LOL.

So yeah, here's a couple of cool things happening recently:

[b]6 Month Development Sprint[/b]

I just finished a 6 month long sprint where I worked on my game [i]any[/i] chance I could get. It felt great, and I made so much progress. A ton of systems got done or nearly done, like the tennis matches themselves, boss battles, dialogue, and some RPG mechanics. I posted a lot of this over on the Tiktok and Twitter, so if you're curious you can check it out! It's definitely felt more and more like a real GAME and it feels really cool to make it come to life.

I'll talk more about the progress in a [i]Youtube[/i] video I'm making (see next section), but I actually went so hard on the game these 6 months that I need a little break! I'll talk about that more in a bit.

[b]Youtube 2-Year Devlog Coming Soon[/b]

I've never seriously edited a Youtube video before, but I want to make a 20-30min video covering my development journey with The Tennis Academy so far the past 2 years I've been working on it. I think it would be fun and a nice time capsule to look at later, and other solo developers might be curious about my process. I've already recorded footage, so I've just been editing the 10,000 "umm"s and "like"s out lol. It's going to have a really detailed look at everything I've worked on for the game so far, with gameplay footage and art, so if you're curious to see more of the game it'll be a good opportunity! :)

[b]Side Project: Horror RPG[/b]

So I mentioned needing a tiny little break from my game. After going really hard for 6 months, I started to notice signs of burnout, which is a No-Good!!! I want to enjoy working on my game, so I decided I need to stop forcing myself to work on it for a little bit so I can come back refreshed. The break was great, and it helped me come up with an idea that had perfect timing: the next feature I wanted to work on for Tennis Academy was the levelling system for the RPG, and there's a local Halloween Indie Game Showcase coming up in October. So, I decided I would build the levelling system into a short horror game over these next couple of months. That way, I could feel satisfied finishing a small game, and the progress would still go towards Tennis Academy! The idea has given me a lot of motivation to keep going, so whether this little horror game is good or not, I don't regret making it! :) Wish me luck on finishing by October!!


That's all I have for now! If people enjoy these, I can start making more regular development updates, or I can make overviews for different characters/environments/mechanics. Lmk! 

Thanks so much for all your support, I really appreciate it! It gives me fuel to keep going!! Later gamers :)
